Morgan: Heads up — iOS sample app (Swift SDK) is printing Bearer tokens to device console when Telemetry is started at debug. Repro below, this looks like a hook ordering + retry weirdness.

Ashley: oh no, any PII leaked?

Morgan: Just auth header contents in debug logs on simulator. Example dump: 
```
2026-03-20 09:12:03.112 SampleApp[1234:56789] [Telemetry DEBUG] outgoing request: POST /v1/generate
headers: { Authorization: Bearer abc.def.ghijklmnop, X-Request-Id: 9f8a7b }
```

Jamal: that looks like the redact hook didn't run before the log path. Which SDK version?

Morgan: Using the iOS quickstart sample app from `main` branch — Telemetry SDK v0.11.0-rc. Autoinit happens in AppDelegate -> background fetch race.

Priya: I think we've seen this for mobile when `level: .debug` plus `autoinit=true`. Debug logs call a generic serializer that logs headers before OTLP hook mutates them.

Emily: Repro steps? I can try on a device.

Morgan: Steps: 1) clone repo `mobile-sample/swift` 2) set API key env in Xcode scheme 3) run simulator 4) trigger sample generation 5) check Xcode console for Telemetry DEBUG messages. Happens intermittently on first launch after install.

Ashley: Is the request id stable across retries? I remember a bug where retry middleware replaced X-Request-Id with a short id and then OTEL hook reattached original, leading to duplicate/ambiguous IDs.

Morgan: Yup — when the SDK retries (exponential backoff), we sometimes end up with 2 different reqids logged for same logical call. Example: `X-Request-Id: 9f8a7b` then later `X-Request-Id: retry-1-3f2e` in same flow.

Jamal: Minimal patch: 1) ensure redact hook runs before any logging path, 2) ensure retry middleware preserves incoming request-id header value (dont mutate it), 3) add unit test that simulates autoinit race + retry.

Priya: Suggestion: change default log level in sample app to `.info` and surface debug-only dumps behind an env flag `SAMPLE_TELEMETRY_DEBUG=1`. Also add a pre-log scrubber: `Telemetry.onBeforeLog { scrubHeaders(&headers) }`.

Emily: Quick workaround for customers: upgrade to SDK v0.11.1 (hotfix branch) — it defers the log emission until after OTLP hooks run. We should verify release notes mention the redaction fix.
